note: AC-6: SplitMix64 points (seed 0x5ec7); per point: p = (U(-0.05,0.05), U(-0.05,0.05), U(0,0.1)), kind = next() % 16 (0 no projection, 1 no sign, 2 no normal, else both), d = U(-1e-4,1e-4), v = 3 x U(-1,1), normal = v / |v| (or z when |v| < 0.25). U(lo,hi) = lo + ((next() >> 11) * 2^-53) * (hi - lo). The digest is SHA-256 over, per run (normal3d then inplane), per section in chain order: u32 index, f64 position, u32 count and (u32 index, f64 dev) per member, u32 count and (u32 index, u8 reason 0 no_sign 1 no_normal) per withheld point, u32 count and u32 index per oblique point, u32 no-projection count, u8 flags (1 empty, 2 oblique, 4 no_projection, 8 withheld); little-endian.
